definitions.content:
Peripheral recipient devices need to be examined and tested only once while being connected to a weighing instrument, and may be declared as suitable for connection to any verified weighing instrument having an appropriate and protective interface.

Purely digital peripheral devices need not be tested for static temperatures (A.5.3), humidity (B.2), and span stability (B.4). They need not be tested for disturbances (B.3) if conformity to the relevant IEC Standards is otherwise established to at least the same level as required in this Recommendation.
